# Asolaria Rainbow81 — Public computational verification report
**Evidence cutoff:** 14 October 2026 · **Scope:** public, reproducible software experiments, not a peer-reviewed physics paper.

## Executive finding
Four *computational* seats now have readable public records in the [Stone-to-Moss GitHub repository](https://github.com/JesseBrown1980/asolaria-stone-to-moss). The primary laws, hash cascades, mutation controls, optical-feature aliases, and reference quantum/gravity simulations are reproducible **within their programmed mathematical definitions**. The records do **not** establish four physically independent hosts, superluminal communication, experimental entanglement, or an emergent physical gravitational field.

This report is a **public technical release**. No claim of journal acceptance, independent laboratory replication, or successful Hugging Face publication is made.

## Independently tested scientific controls

- **Nine-wave source-hash cascade:** nine perturbations each recomputed 81 derivative cells, 405 five-label hash commitments and 171 ring commitments. No peer stored hash changed in the negative control **without explicit recomputation**.
- **27-wave position control:** identity hashes remained stable across assigned coordinate scales 1, 10⁶ and 10⁹; ring dependencies propagated at the specified digital rounds. Different assigned physical distances can share the same identity digest, so physical separation cannot be inferred from the digest alone.
- **Fifth-feature constructed spectral control:** zero quadratic fifth-feature survivors from 272 exact equal-weight aliases, but **42,688** five-channel accepted unequal pair mixtures out of 411,480 tested and **748** accepted three-body mixtures out of 85,320. **123,904** pair/weight cases have an adversarial bounded-noise assignment consistent with false acceptance; this is feasibility, not measured experimental frequency.
- **81-body quantum reference:** local deterministic hidden-variable CHSH (S=2); explicitly programmed quantum singlet (S=2\sqrt2\approx2.8284). A restricted 81-site GHZ sampler passed its internal checks but is not an entanglement witness.
- **Force reference:** an explicit Newtonian-type `U ∝ -1/r` law produces the expected (1/r^2) force; an explicit `U ∝ -1/r^2` light-intensity potential produces its gradient (1/r^3). **Neither force emerged from hashing**, and no gravitational constant or physical signal speed was measured.
- **Cross-runtime 10¹³-step stress test:** Python GF(2) matrices and independent Node GF(2) cyclic-polynomial exponentiation match over 4,860 state records; two cloud-hosted OS runners agree with SHA-256 `031367b1da1a368dc7471141a9799b79c694a0c9900f65a047438ccaa5f76600`. These are mathematical jumps computed using exponentiation, **not elapsed 10¹³ time steps**.

**Later software-only addendum (not another physical seat):** [Seat 3's merged PR #11](https://github.com/JesseBrown1980/asolaria-stone-to-moss/pull/11) records an additional **9,720** independently matched two-horizon 81-bit GF(2) state rows under the newer five-tap fixture, at `10^13` and `10^13 + 1` modeled steps. Independent [CI 38647138816](https://github.com/JesseBrown1980/asolaria-stone-to-moss/actions/runs/38647138816) passed. The rebuilt HBP digest is `245ab02b30cbdd9215d161c6561adc6a6c3bf72dd3fa2cb62979b2fb74031cef`. This **does not change** the original four-seat counts or provide a new physical-host attestation. See the [versioned release addendum](SEAT3-9720-ADDENDUM.md) for exact laws, source links, and limitations.

**Further Seat 1 follow-on (newly merged [PR #14](https://github.com/JesseBrown1980/asolaria-stone-to-moss/pull/14), software only):** 27 symbolic time/color/space input combinations × 81 bodies × five *new* taps × three modeled horizons (`10^13`, `10^13+1`, `10^13+81`) produced **32,805** exact Python/Node records, SHA-256 `720d0c44ede086c9ff3cccb807f4ba222145455c80614cdf3abcd710b93a11c3`. Independent [CI 38652231747](https://github.com/JesseBrown1980/asolaria-stone-to-moss/actions/runs/38652231747) passed on Ubuntu and Windows. The triad challenge nonce was publicly issued after software preregistration, **not** after physically independent host commitments.

**Separate information-retention experiment (merged [PR #15](https://github.com/JesseBrown1980/asolaria-stone-to-moss/pull/15)):** exact GF(2) rank/nullspace comparison shows the new tap laws at 81 cells have ranks 80, 80, 81, 81, 80. The old CA150/CA90/CA60/CA102/SHIFT ranks are 79, 80, 80, 80, 81. Under uniform inputs, a rank-80 linear map irreversibly loses one recoverable source bit; rank 79 loses two, while rank 81 is reversible. Across all four positive modeled horizons, independent Python/Node algorithms match 40/40 records, SHA-256 `f4a0f2f19eb72930035b92356f0b2099655ba2f0d5e4640a4c0a1df29209de78`. [Independent four-job CI 38653107657](https://github.com/JesseBrown1980/asolaria-stone-to-moss/actions/runs/38653107657) passed. See [full information-retention mathematical report](INFORMATION-RETENTION-81.md). These are **digital operator invertibility results**, not physical entropy, quantum or gravity measurements.

## Exact reproductions and audit commands

From the pinned source commit of the relevant experiment (Python 3.11+ and Node 18+):

```sh
node physical/make_preflight_fixture.js challenge.json
python physical/evolve_gf2_python.py challenge.json python-result.hbp --self-test
node physical/evolve_gf2_node.js challenge.json node-result.hbp --self-test
python physical/verify_seat1_computational.py --challenge challenge.json --python-hbp python-result.hbp --node-hbp node-result.hbp
node experiments/seat3/verify_public_seat3.js
python experiments/seat4/verify_seat4.py
python tools/audit_four_seat_release.py
```

The check-in and GHZ/quantum controls are independent **software** verification, not physical measurements. The Seat 2 signature format requires the original exact signed-message preimage definition before a third party can verify its Ed25519 signature. A mismatch of canonicalization alone is not evidence of forgery.

## Publication and scientific validation gates

1. **GitHub release dossier:** this report and source are public. The repository is a live source tree; maintain fixed commit SHA, SHA-256 manifests and append-only corrections rather than changing old stones.
2. **Hugging Face mirror:** **not verified published**. [Last verified upload blocker](../../tracking/HF-QG81-PUBLICATION-STATUS-2026-10-14.md) is a missing write-capable `HF_TOKEN` GitHub Actions secret. Upload and *download-back SHA verification* must both pass before completion is claimed. Do not reuse publicly exposed tokens; rotate and provision a new secret in GitHub settings.
3. **Three-physical-host experiment:** **not done**. Requires three real devices, independently attested physical separation, protocol-compliant signing/precommits, a **new challenge issued afterward**, compute commitments, reveal and referee. [Handoff](../../physical/README.md). The fourth computational observer cannot replace a physical host.
4. **Source-law normalization:** preserve CA150/90/60/102/SHIFT vs newer stress-tap groups as separate versioned workloads. Recover original historic five-law source/seed before claiming exact replay.
5. **Physical measurements:** calibrated instruments and clocks, explicit separation and communication/no-signaling controls, optical/gravitational measurement model, preregistered falsification. No current software receipt substitutes for data.
6. **Scholarly publication:** paper authorship, institutional attribution/permissions, repository reuse license, manuscript review and outside physical replication are not completed by a GitHub push. No DOI or peer-review acceptance claimed.

## Provenance policy

Keep private keys, signing salts before reveal, HF tokens, machine serials, public IPs and identifying hardware traces out of published receipts. Separate session signatures, cloud runners and physical machines. Report negative results and append corrected stones rather than rewriting prior evidence.
